# Module query_source

[Source](../../src/diesel/query_source/mod.rs.html#1-266)

Expand description

Types related to describing schema, and interactions between tables.

Most traits in this module are derived or generated by [`table!`](../macro.table.html).

## Structs[§](#structs)

[Alias](struct.Alias.html)Represents an alias within diesel’s query builder[AliasedField](struct.AliasedField.html)Represents an aliased field (column) within diesel’s query builder[MoreThanOnce](struct.MoreThanOnce.html)A table appears in the from clause two or more times.[Never](struct.Never.html)A table never appears in the from clause.[Once](struct.Once.html)A table appears in the from clause exactly one time.

## Traits[§](#traits)

[AliasSource](trait.AliasSource.html)Types created by the `alias!` macro that serve to distinguish between aliases implement
this trait.[AppearsInFromClause](trait.AppearsInFromClause.html)Determines how many times `Self` appears in `QS`[Column](trait.Column.html)A column on a database table. Types which implement this trait should have
